"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians should have the freedom to stay, the freedom to move, and the freedom to return to their homes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand for the right for all Palestinians to travel freely to Palestine with no interrogations, deportations, racial or religious profiling, or militarized borders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Return is the first step towards realizing historic justice and decolonizing Palestinian lands.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand for freedom for all Palestinians.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Demand for the end of Israel’s ongoing illegal military occupation, including East Jerusalem and the blockade against Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, and apartheid policies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Demand for the right to move freely and to live wherever Palestinians choose.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Indigenous people of Palestine are entitled to full freedom on their land.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Demand for the freedom to thrive and live in safety and dignity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Demand for an end to Israel’s structural violence and systematic destruction of Palestinian lives and livelihoods.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians cannot thrive with a boot on their necks.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Demand for a just and liberated society that is free of classism, patriarchy, homophobia, racism, and bigotry in all forms.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Without stability, safety, and agency, Palestinians cannot live full lives.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
